system.history:
An ordinary person overwhelmed by immediate danger, confusion, or separation from someone important.

Scene use: Rescue complication, frightened witness, crowd catalyst, or civilian who needs calm instructions before moving to safety.
system.personality: Frightened and reactive rather than irrational. Give them one concrete concern such as a missing child, trapped coworker, pet, medication, or blocked exit.
system.distinguishingFeatures: Disordered clothing, a dropped possession, and visible attention fixed on the source of danger.

system.description: An uncontrolled close attempt to push past an immediate threat.
